text:
Nina (CS): quick capture from three onboarding calls this afternoon — recurring asks: per-route cost breakdown in Console, one-click export of feature asks for product teams, and a simple "re-embed" action after model swaps.
Liam (Account Lead): +1. two accounts in trial mentioned they'll pause rollout if invoices spike again. renewal window for one is 28 days.
Zoe (SE): quick engineering take: CSV export of feature asks is low lift (~1 dev day). per-route breakdown needs a daily aggregation job + small UI (~2w). re-embed button depends on the embedding pipeline but could be a guarded API endpoint (~4d).
Rahul (PM): thanks. proposal: ship CSV export and a short-term banner showing top-consuming route for 7 days (to reduce surprise) as quick wins. longer-term: per-route dashboard and re-embed feature.
Nina (CS): sample quotes to include in tickets: "We keep getting surprise invoices and can't tell which route did it." and "After you changed the default model, our search got worse — we wish we could re-run embeddings without contacting support."
Rahul (PM): can CS include account tier + renewal date with each raw ask? that'll help triage.
Nina (CS): yes — i'll batch them in the canonical capture format (quote, tier, renewal, impact). aiming to push 10 items by EOD.
Zoe (SE): also request telemetry: `route.token_usage.daily` and `embed.job.triggered_by_user` so we can audit and expose the button safely.
deploy-bot: created ticket CS-7119 "Feature-asks bulk export" and CS-7120 "Cost-banner + quick route visibility".
Liam (Account Lead): I've added account IDs and renewal notes to CS-7119 (ACME-7, NOVA-21). tagging as high for accounts in 30d window.
Rahul (PM): i'll slot CS-7119 into the next sprint; CS-7120 into the hotfix lane for the banner experiment. we'll loop in Enablement for copy.
Nina (CS): will attach verbatim quotes and renewal-sensitive flags to both tickets. also pinging if we need any blocked by infra changes.
Zoe (SE): noted — will follow up on telemetry schema and exact estimates by tomorrow morning.
Liam (Account Lead): thanks all — if anything scores high on renewal risk, i'll prioritize outreach.
